verdict_classification_rationale: T04 native-smoke verdict is the deterministic function f(t02_contract_present, t03_deploy_present, fresh_readback_performed, session_cookie_available, bounded_native_smoke_attempted) → BLOCKED_NO_LIVE_API. Per MEM139 (no-promotion ledger), this artifact records the BLOCKED verdict honestly without false PASS claims.
